ns2:course.label: Special Problems in Design
ns2:course.description: Directed independent creative activity or research. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing in Art and Design; and consent of instructor, advisor, and associate director of the School. A contract must be completed & approved by the instructor & advisor. 3.3 GPA, & only 6 hours total Ind. Study.
